entities.summary: Ibrahim Bilali is a retired flyweight boxer from Kenya, who won a bronze medal in the flyweight division at the 1984 Summer Olympics in Los Angeles, California. In the semifinals he was defeated by Redzep Redzepovski of Yugoslavia, the eventual silver medalist.
